note: Environment variable NAMES only. Values are NEVER stored here or anywhere in this repo. Check drift with `npm run env:check`. Completeness is checked against process.env.* references in apps/web/src, so an undeclared variable is reported.

required.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: Every Stripe call. Without it (or with a rolled key) the site serves perfectly and cannot take a single payment — /api/health/payments exists because that happened.
required.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: Signature verification on the ONLY fulfilment path. Missing or wrong = every paid order is silently never fulfilled.
required.CRON_SECRET: Bearer auth on all 19 scheduled routes. Missing = every cron 401s and the whole automation engine stops.
required.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY: Public by design (shipped in every page). Firestore is protected by the catch-all deny in firestore.rules, not by this being secret.

degradesQuietly.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: Newsroom, concierge, sales agent, ScrapeFlow extraction, and the translation fallback. Absent = those features silently stop producing.
degradesQuietly.RESEND_API_KEY: Transactional and alert email. Absent = alerts are written to Firestore but nobody is told.
degradesQuietly.SALES_FROM_EMAIL: From address on outbound mail; falls back to a default.
degradesQuietly.GA4_PROPERTY_ID: Analytics dashboard prefers GA4, falls back to first-party events.
degradesQuietly.TICKETMASTER_API_KEY: Real event sync; absent = no new events.
degradesQuietly.NOVU_SECRET_KEY: Operator push notifications; dormant without it.
degradesQuietly.ELEVATE_PARTNER_SECRET: Partner integration; set by the deploy workflow from a GitHub secret.
degradesQuietly.SALES_PHYSICAL_ADDRESS: CAN-SPAM postal address on outbound marketing email. UNSET IS A COMPLIANCE GAP: the fallback is 'CityBeat Media Group, El Paso, TX, USA' — a city and state with no street address or PO box, which does not satisfy the requirement. OPERATOR ACTION: set this to a real mailing address.
degradesQuietly.NEWSLETTER_POSTAL_ADDRESS: Same, for the newsletter footer. Same compliance gap when unset.
degradesQuietly.UNSUB_TOKEN_SECRET: HMAC key for unsubscribe tokens. Falls back to CRON_SECRET (a real secret), so unset is not weak — but rotating CRON_SECRET then invalidates every outstanding unsubscribe link.
degradesQuietly.AUDIT_IP_SALT: Salt for hashing IPs in the verification audit log. Falls back to CRON_SECRET; same rotation caveat.
degradesQuietly.LEADS_FROM_EMAIL: From address on lead notifications; falls back to the default sender.
degradesQuietly.NEWSLETTER_FROM_EMAIL: From address on the weekly digest; falls back to the default sender.
degradesQuietly.REPORTS_FROM_EMAIL: From address on owner ROI reports; falls back to the default sender.
degradesQuietly.RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET: Verifies Resend delivery/bounce webhooks. Unset means those events are unauthenticated or rejected.
degradesQuietly.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_JSON: Service-account JSON for GA4. Falls back to the Cloud Run service identity.

optional.FIRESTORE_DATABASE_ID: DISASTER RECOVERY ONLY. Unset resolves to (default). A Firestore restore always creates a NEW database, so pointing at restored data is this config change rather than an emergency code edit. See the DR runbook in CLAUDE.md.
optional.CHAT_HOURLY_CAP: Global hourly ceiling on the paid-LLM chat endpoint (default 500).
optional.TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS: How many proxies append to X-Forwarded-For (default 1). Wrong value makes every rate limit either bypassable or self-inflicted.
optional.EMAIL_TIMEOUT_MS: Overrides the 10s hard bound on every email send.
optional.SMTP_HOST: Preferred email provider when set (with SMTP_USER/SMTP_PASS).
optional.CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_EMAILS: Set to 'on' to let the recovery cron actually email customers.
optional.ANALYTICS_EXCLUDED_IPS: Comma-separated IPs excluded from first-party page-view counts.
optional.MEDIA_BUCKET: Storage bucket for uploads; defaults to kerstenblueprint-media.
optional.WORKER_URL: Cloudflare worker base URL; has a default.
optional.ALERT_SMS_TO: Comma-separated numbers for SMS escalation on the failures that mean the business has stopped. Dormant until set (also needs the Twilio vars).
optional.RELAY_SMS: Enables SMS on the unclaimed-listing lead relay. Deliberately off.
optional.NEXT_PUBLIC_RELEASE: Release tag surfaced in error reports.
optional.NEWSROOM_MODEL: Overrides the model used by the autonomous newsroom.
optional.REWRITE_MODEL: Overrides the model used by article rewriting.
optional.SCRAPEFLOW_MODEL: Overrides the model used by ScrapeFlow extraction.
optional.TICKETMASTER_AFFILIATE_WRAP: Wraps ticket links for affiliate revenue.

platformProvided.K_REVISION: Set by Cloud Run. Surfaced by /api/health so a response identifies its revision.
